WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

5. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

6. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.

7. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

9. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

10. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.

11. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Blending wood with other materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
